programs.desc: A musician's journey to create a song with some of the biggest stars in the industry. Along the way, he faces up to his painful past, while giving viewers a deep personal insight into the issue of bullying.

programs.title: Spy Dog
programs.desc: Toby appears to be an ordinary dog living the simple put life, but unbeknownst to his family, he moonlights as secret government operative, Agent Toby Barks. AKA Agent Toby Barks

programs.title: Designed with Love
programs.desc: Trying to find a market for her clothing line, designer Skye goes mobile with a 'fashion truck' – but can’t drive the truck and run the business all alone. Help comes in the unlikely form of handsome Kevin, an entrepeneur with a history of flipping businesses. As they start on their new quest, Kevin and Skye find that they have more in common than they thought, while their feelings for each other grow stronger.

programs.title: For the Love of Chocolate
programs.desc: As Aria gets ready for the yearly Masters of Chocolate Festival, things take a turn when her partner quits just before the big event. But soon, a charming single dad comes to her rescue, helping her discover the secret to winning.

programs.title: A Star is Born (1937)
programs.desc: Young Esther Victoria Blodgett arrives in Hollywood with big dreams of becoming a star. She manages to make it big with help from Norman Maine, a leading actor battling alcoholism, whose glory days are fading.
